cells.gaps: No source gives a count of pilot establishments or says whether they are primary or secondary, and none reports FIUE-BF or the national pupil file past its pilot: at 25 June 2025 enrolment had not begun and at 14 April 2025 the student management platform was still to be designed. The KIX-SEEDS platform, a university project in which teachers enter marks and heads follow attendance, was still a pilot in the communes of Manga and Bingo in May 2026 (BFA-020, BFA-021), and it is not the ministry's register. The sources disagree on how the record is kept (routine entry in the pilots, BFA-009 mainly hard copies in April 2025); finance was the general budget in February 2024 (BFA-014) and donor only in the newer rows; no current plan naming the system has been found.
cells.note: FIUE-BF was at its pilot phase in February 2024, its successors were still being prepared in 2025, and the KIX-SEEDS marks-and-attendance platform was a two-commune pilot in May 2026, which is stage 2. Stage 3 needs live use past a pilot or a register filled past its pilot, and no row reports either.
